versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-creator-videos skill.

- Enables keyword search, sorting, and multi-dimensional filtering for Douyin (抖音) videos and images.
- Supports real-time hot search queries, public creator video list retrieval, and detailed comment analysis.
- Command-line tools provided for searching, hot list retrieval, creator post scraping, and comment data extraction.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; see documentation for setup and usage examples.
- Read-only access—handles only public data; no login or write operations supported.
- Output is structured JSON for easy downstream analysis and reporting.
